subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, with this PR's no-override legacy behavior and hook-extra tier semantics?
rationale: The code path is bounded, but the feature changes public configuration and session-context policy in an area that overlaps other bootstrap/context controls, so automation should not decide the product contract.

options.title: Accept After Contract Docs
options.body: Proceed with this PR shape once public docs describe the new option, no-override legacy behavior, explicit tiers, and hook-extra semantics.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Bootstrap Design
options.body: Pause this PR behind the broader bootstrap/context-injection proposals if maintainers want one unified selector instead of another config knob.

options.title: Decline New Config Surface
options.body: Close or replace the PR if maintainers prefer existing bootstrap budgets, `contextInjection`, and lightweight modes over adding `bootstrapTier`.

recommendation.title: Accept After Contract Docs
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR shape once public docs describe the new option, no-override legacy behavior, explicit tiers, and hook-extra semantics.
